title: Return zero for the average of an empty list
body:
calculate_average([]) raises ZeroDivisionError. The expected result is 0. Preserve normal averages for non-empty lists, including negative numbers.

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "calculator.py", line 2, in calculate_average
    return sum(values) / len(values)
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
